newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks crawl lower in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks crawl lower in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks crawled lower in early Wednesday morning trade after the Nikkei average poked up to end over the 20,500 level on the previous day, brokers said. They said overall sentiment was not bad judging from the rise on Tuesday, but investors were sticking to the sidelines.
At 0015 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was down 32.36 points at 0.16 percent at 20,527.23. Its December futures were up 20 points at 20,590.
"The Nikkei 225 September options and futures expire later in the week and participants are reluctant to buy ahead of it," Hiroshi Morimoto, general manager at Daiwa Securities said.
